_doc.purpose: Localization companion for Stats_Derived.json. Holds en-us entries for the housekeeping-related derived stats.
_doc.stamina_tooltip_note: zh-cn source replaced its trailing %%notimplemented%% with a reference to %%chara_status_fatigue%% (now translated as 'Stamina' this session, see Chara_Status_loc.json). Stale en-us entry (still ending in %%notimplemented%%) removed from Stats_Derived.json and replaced here.

zh-cn.v_lubrication_tooltip: 阴道的派生润滑度；部位内液体的润滑加成另行计算。数值为暂定调参，并非最终生理设定。
zh-cn.a_lubrication_tooltip: 肛门的派生润滑度；默认快感系数为0，特性可启用该加成通道。部位内液体的润滑加成另行计算。数值为暂定调参，并非最终生理设定。
zh-cn.o_lubrication_tooltip: 口腔的派生润滑度；部位内液体的润滑加成另行计算。数值为暂定调参，并非最终生理设定。
zh-cn.ui_bodyLubrication_breakdown:
派生润滑度：$derived$（$stat$）
液体润滑加成：$liquid$
部位内全部液体：$amount$ ml
液体加成按部位内全部液体的毫升数计算，不按容量占比计算；不是永久加成。

en-us.v_lubrication_tooltip: Derived vaginal lubrication; the organ's liquid lubrication bonus is calculated separately. Values are provisional tuning, not final physiology.
en-us.a_lubrication_tooltip: Derived anal lubrication; the default stimulation coefficient is 0, but traits can enable this modifier channel. The organ's liquid lubrication bonus is calculated separately. Values are provisional tuning, not final physiology.
en-us.o_lubrication_tooltip: Derived oral lubrication; the organ's liquid lubrication bonus is calculated separately. Values are provisional tuning, not final physiology.
en-us.ui_bodyLubrication_breakdown:
Derived lubrication: $derived$ ($stat$)
Liquid lubrication bonus: $liquid$
All liquid in this organ: $amount$ ml
The liquid bonus uses all liquid in this organ, measured in ml, not a fraction of capacity; it is not a permanent bonus.
en-us.stats_derived_extended_stamina_tooltip:
Consumed when performing physical labor
Maximum is %%stats_base_Constitution%%*10 + other modifiers
Recovers via sleep or rest
When Stamina is too low, character enters a fatigued state - see the %%chara_status_fatigue%% status for details
en-us.stats_derived_cleaningThreshold_tooltip:
This value determines how dirty a room (or the traces on their body) must get before the character decides to clean it (or shower in their free time) - the lower it is, the more diligent they are.
Default 3, minimum 2
en-us.stats_derived_cleanlinessSensitivity_too:
This value (a multiplier) determines how much mess a character can tolerate in a room and on their body - the higher it is, the less tolerant.
Default 1.0
en-us.stats_derived_wakeupOffset_tooltip:
Whether the character wakes up on time or stays up late, default 0 (on time).
When this value is above 0, the character goes to bed and wakes up early; below 0, they go to bed and wake up late.
en-us.stats_derived_painSensitivity_tooltip:
This value (multiplier) determines how easily the character feels pain; lower means more intense pain
Default 1.0
At 0, the character feels no pain at all
Also affects %%experience_pain%% gain during training
